definition: availableBytes = (freePages + speculativePages + purgeablePages + reclaimableFilePages) * pageSizeBytes < 2^63; reclaimableFilePages = max(0, fileBackedPages - speculativePages) (Activity Monitor Cached Files); anonymous, inactive, throttled and active pages are recorded for audit only
identity: File-backed pages + Anonymous pages = Pages active + Pages inactive + Pages speculative + Pages throttled (every valid case)
